content.comment_body: I have [product_name] installed on an older computer, but I can't find it in the license manager. I want to transfer it to a new computer and retire the old one. I installed the software on the new computer, but only the demo version works. Is there a way to complete this transfer? I read online that this is a single install.

For [product_name], there isn't a license key system like with some other software. You purchase a full version just once, typically using the original CD. If you still have the older full version CD, you're able to upgrade to the latest version at no extra cost. There is also an FAQ available on this topic. The FAQ describes how to install an upgrade you’ve downloaded for [product_name], regardless of whether [product_name] is installed or not.
What can be done if the physical CD is lost?
In that case, you will need to purchase a new CD or DVD.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges when trying to move [product_name] software to a new computer, especially if the installation originated from a physical CD and there is no visible license management for transfer or recovery. The absence of digital licensing or transfer options, unlike other software solutions, leads to confusion and may result in extra costs if the original CD is missing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate being able to transfer software ownership or activation from one device to another using digital license management or a similar process, even if the original CD is not available.
